text: The legacy private investment fund model delays liquidity: the investment process is long, complex and time intensive and leads up to a very late liquidity event in the form of an IPO or acquisition, which is why funds seek the early liquidity cryptocurrencies provide.
citation: Kaal, Financial Technology and Hedge Funds (2019). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3409548
abstract: In the existing legacy business for private investment funds, the investment process is subject to long, complex, and time intensive processes leading up to a very late liquidity event in the form of an IPO or acquisition.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: private investment funds investing in blockchain start-ups
